sources.title: Adaptive drafter model uses downtime to double LLM training speed
sources.snippet: Researchers from MIT and elsewhere found a way to use this computational downtime to efficiently accelerate reasoning-model training. Their new method automatically trains a smaller, faster model to predict the outputs of the larger reasoning LLM, which the larger model verifies.
